name: movement-md1
family: positional-guide movement director vs control methods (E-MD1)
origin: tranche 3a (Flux muwufpp tjyuteu); scripts ported from test-results/experiments/tranche3a/scripts/{assets,build_md1,run_md1,analyze_md1}.py — spec docs/research/h3-sampler-shaping-and-motion-control.md §3
measures: Trajectory adherence: ball-centroid x error vs the plan at the checkpoints (pixel HSV tracker, cross-checked against direct pixel measurement), backtrack/teleport event counts, background PSNR vs the base render (appearance lock), wall-clock.

fixtures.scene: locked-tripod empty wooden table; direction NEVER stated in any prompt
fixtures.sceneText: Locked tripod medium shot of a plain weathered wooden table under soft even daylight from a nearby window, an empty tabletop, a plain wall in the background. No people, no camera movement.
fixtures.audioClause: Audio: a quiet room tone hum. non_diegetic_music: N/A
fixtures.promptControl: <sceneText>A red ball rolls across the table. <audio>

keyframePlan.description: ball centroid at 25%/50%/75% of width at frames 0/17/34, linear between, extrapolated to f38 = 80.88%

fixtures.inputAssets: testbed input/exp_md1/ (sprite.png, base/f*.png, guide_f*.png, spritectl/f*.png, base_audio.wav — derived by assets_md1.py from the base render)

A.label: control — no guides, direction unstated (direction roulette)

B.label: AddGuide positional stills at 0/17/34 — the MEASURED WINNER (0.0-1.7% error, zero events; the product movement director)

C.label: guides + spatial path-band denoise mask (init latent = encoded base, rows 14-22 feather 0.5; +1 dB preservation, no grid artifact)

D.label: Fun Control union over sprite control video (correct direction, scene roulette)

E.label: VDN-arch + guides (boundary-anchor hypothesis: B-identical tracking on the VDN patch)

candidateSlot.description: A candidate MOVEMENT-CONTROL METHOD slots in on the same scene+plan: an alternative guide keyframe plan (positions/frames), or an alternative control-video provider (a new controlnet/sprite composite), or a VDN/config variant.

slotFields.guideFractions: ball x as fraction of width at the guide frames (guide-plan)
slotFields.controlDir: testbed input dir with f%06d.png control frames (control-video)

rubric.contact: 12-up contact sheet of a table scene with a red ball. Judge: (1) does the ball travel left-to-right across the frame; (2) is the scene a plain weathered wooden table under even daylight (no invented set dressing, no relocated window, no color drift); (3) is the ball RED (not maroon/near-black).

limits: The HSV tracker cannot follow arms that render the ball off-color (measured: arm D renders maroon) — those positions are vision-read from full-res frames and labeled as such; contact-sheet vision position estimates were measured ±16% wrong at 288px tiles (trust pixel metrics for positions, vision for semantics).
Arm C depends on the t3a_shims (T3aEncodeH3AVLatent + T3aSetH3SpatialNoiseMask) living on the testbed (gitignored there).
Trajectory quality is judged against a LINEAR plan; a candidate whose value is expressive non-linear motion needs a plan-aware metric before the verdict is meaningful.
